summary: Iteration 14 — Verified Meta Ads Token Exchange feature (POST /api/meta/exchange-token + Settings UI). All 6 new backend tests + 7 pre-existing friendly-error tests pass (13/13). Settings UI renders blue dashed-border 'تحويل تلقائي إلى Long-lived Token (60 يوم)' section correctly. Exchange button correctly disabled when input empty, enabled after typing. Toast on submit shows friendly Arabic message (no raw JSON / OAuthException / English leak). All required testids present. Mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x800) have NO horizontal overflow. Iteration 13 regression suite (6/6) still passes — no regression introduced.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor doc/testid mismatch in review request: spec mentioned 'meta-short-lived-token-input' and 'meta-access-token-input' testids, but actual SecretField component emits '-input-masked' (when hidden) or '-textarea' (when revealed). Not a bug — main agent should update docs/spec for future testers. All masking/toggle/copy/clear testids work correctly.

Frontend exchange flow pre-validates required form fields (App ID + Secret + Ad Account ID) before POSTing. This is good UX but means UI never actually hits backend friendly-error path when all 3 fields are unset. Backend friendly-error path is fully covered by pytest (13/13 passing), so this is acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SecretField uses testidPrefix; actual rendered testids are '{prefix}-input-masked' (when hidden) and '{prefix}-textarea' (when revealed) — NOT '{prefix}-input'. To type in a SecretField, click the '-toggle' first then fill '-textarea'. Exchange button is disabled-by-empty-input — gate works correctly. Toast (sonner) text can be polled via querySelectorAll('[role=status], [data-sonner-toast]'). When config not stored, clicking exchange triggers a client-side validation toast 'Meta App ID و App Secret و Ad Account ID مطلوبة (احفظهم أولاً أو املأهم في النموذج).' BEFORE POSTing — friendly Arabic, no JSON leak. backend regression test_iteration_13.py needs MongoDB env vars (source /app/backend/.env before pytest). The 3 pre-existing failures in test_meta_integration.py mentioned by main agent were NOT re-run and remain out of scope.
